jobs_results.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health. 

 By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare. 

 Role Summary: 

 The Customer Insights Analyst will transform customer and operational data into clear, actionable insights for our Payer Retrieval business. This role will collect, analyze, and visualize data to identify trends, monitor performance, and help teams better understand customer needs and business outcomes. The analyst will partner with Customer Success, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop dashboards, respond to business questions, and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and operational performance. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Collect, clean, and analyze customer and operational data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. 

 Develop and maintain Sigma dashboards, recurring reports, and performance summaries that provide visibility into key customer and business metrics. 

 Use SQL to retrieve, combine, and analyze data in support of reporting and business decision-making. 

 Monitor key performance indicators and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for Customer Success, Operations, and business leaders. 

 Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer questions related to customer performance, medical record retrieval, operational outcomes, and business trends. 

 Develop presentations and visual stories that communicate complex findings in a clear and compelling way. 

 Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, define reporting requirements, and recommend analytical solutions. 

 Identify inefficiencies, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities through quantitative analysis. 

 Support the evaluation of business initiatives by measuring results and assessing their impact on customer and operational outcomes. 

 Document business requirements, metric definitions, analytical methodologies, and key findings. 

 Validate data accuracy and consistency across dashboards, reports, and analyses. 

 Support the continued development of scalable reporting and customer insights capabilities within the Payer Retrieval business. 

 Other relevant duties and responsibilities as assigned. 

 Basic Qualifications: 

 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field. 

3+ years of experience in business analysis, customer insights, data analytics, operations analytics, or a related role. 

 Experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools, including Sigma Computing. 

 Strong proficiency in SQL and relational database concepts; familiarity with cloud data warehouses, such as Snowflake. 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and develop actionable insights. 

 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. 

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

 Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality. 

 Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 

 Curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn new business processes, tools, and data sources quickly. 

 Hands-on experience building reports in cloud visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI). 

 Desired Qualifications: 

 Hands-on experience building reports in Sigma Computing 

 Experience supporting Customer Success, client-facing, or operational teams through data and insights. 

 Experience within healthcare, health technology, payer services, or medical record retrieval. 

 Familiarity with payer operations, risk adjustment, quality programs, or medical record retrieval workflows. 

 Experience developing customer-facing or executive-level reports and presentations. 

 Knowledge of data modeling, metric development, and dashboard design best practices.

jobs_results.description:
What we’re building and why we’re building it. 




Fetch helps people live rewarded every day, with a vision to become the rewards destination for everyone. We turn everyday activities into meaningful rewards, whether it’s grocery shopping, grabbing a quick meal, or playing a favorite mobile game. To date, we’ve awarded more than $1 billion in Fetch Points to our users.




Each day, more than 13 million receipts are submitted on Fetch, providing visibility into over $212 billion in gross merchandise value. This creates the largest retail-agnostic, SKU-level view of household spending, powering Fetch as an outcomes-based advertising platform that helps brands acquire and retain lifelong consumers.




The Fetch app is available on the App Store and Google Play, with more than 6 million five-star reviews from a highly engaged and loyal user base.




It’s not just our users who believe in Fetch: with investments from Softbank, ICONIQ, DST, Greycroft, and partnerships ranging from challenger brands to Fortune 500 companies, Fetch is reshaping how brands and consumers connect in the marketplace. When you work at Fetch, you play a vital role in a platform that drives brand loyalty and creates lifelong consumers with the power of Fetch points. User and partner success are at the heart of everything we do, and we extend that same commitment to our employees.




At Fetch, we value curiosity, adaptability, and the confidence to explore new tools, especially AI, to drive smarter, faster work. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be ready to learn quickly and think critically. We welcome learners who move fast, challenge the status quo, and shape what’s next, with us.  Ranked as one of America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes for two years in a row, Fetch fosters a people-first culture rooted in trust, accountability, and innovation. We encourage our employees to challenge ideas, think bigger, and always bring the fun to Fetch.

About the Role:




User Support is one of the richest sources of user intelligence at Fetch. Every chat, ticket, survey response, and app review reveals how users experience the Fetch app, where friction exists, and where we can make it easier for users to get value from Fetch.




As a Senior Customer Experience Insights Analyst, you will operationalize the Voice of the Customer by combining qualitative feedback with behavioral, operational, and experience data. You will independently identify recurring user pain points, investigate their root causes, quantify their impact, and translate the evidence into clear recommendations for improving how users discover offers, submit receipts, earn points, shop, play games, redeem rewards, and get help in the Fetch app.




Anchored within Support Operations, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Growth Marketing, Data, and Support leaders to ensure user evidence informs prioritization and decision-making. This role owns the customer evidence, insights, recommendations, and measurement framework while partnering with the teams responsible for solution design and implementation.




This is a highly cross-functional role that combines customer advocacy, customer experience analytics, continuous improvement, and storytelling. Success requires strong analytical judgment, exceptional communication, a genuine passion for representing Fetch users, and the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.




This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States.




Role Responsibilities:




Analyze structured and unstructured user feedback across Support interactions, CSAT surveys, app reviews, customer research, and other listening channels to identify emerging trends and systemic pain points.Combine user feedback with product, behavioral, and operational data to investigate root causes and explain where and why the Fetch experience breaks down.Quantify the frequency, severity, and business impact of user friction across core Fetch experiences.Map end-to-end user journeys to identify experience gaps, recurring points of confusion, and opportunities to reduce user effort.Translate complex customer signals into clear, evidence-based recommendations for product and in-app experience improvements, Support process changes, and policy decisions.Define hypotheses, data requirements, customer experience KPIs, and measurement approaches that help teams evaluate user and business outcomes.Develop dashboards, recurring management reporting, and reusable analytical assets that give leaders visibility into customer experience performance and emerging risks, supported by documented metric definitions, quality checks, and a centralized knowledge base of user learnings.Present executive-ready recommendations supported by both quantitative evidence and real Fetch user stories.Partner with Product, Engineering, Growth Marketing, Data, and Support leaders to bring customer evidence into discovery, planning, rollout, and post-launch evaluation.Support the rollout of customer experience initiatives by surfacing experience risks, sharing relevant user insights, and monitoring early feedback and performance. Measure whether changes improve user sentiment, usability, satisfaction, loyalty, product adoption, customer effort, and Support demand.


What We’re Looking For




Three or more years of experience in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Product Analytics, Operations Analytics, Support Operations, Product Operations, Consulting, or a related field.Experience independently combining quantitative data and qualitative feedback to identify trends, investigate root causes, and turn user pain points into actionable recommendations.Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with business intelligence or visualization tools to analyze large, complex datasets.Experience analyzing Support interactions, survey feedback, app reviews, customer research, or other unstructured feedback at scale.Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to distinguish established findings from hypotheses and clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, and data quality concerns.Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to tailor insights for technical, operational, product, and executive audiences.Experience building authentic cross-functional relationships and influencing prioritization and decisions without direct authority.The ability to independently structure ambiguous customer experience questions, define an analytical approach, and move from data to insight to recommendation.Experience using AI and automation to improve the speed, consistency, quality, and scalability of customer feedback analysis.A genuine passion for representing Fetch users and improving their experience.


What Success Looks Like




Success in this role is measured by the quality, credibility, and adoption of the customer insights you provide; the experience improvements those insights help inform; and the measurable reduction in user friction, effort, and Support demand. You will help ensure every user interaction becomes trusted, actionable intelligence that strengthens the Fetch app and the overall rewards experience.




Compensation:

At Fetch, we offer competitive compensation packages including base, equity, and benefits to the exceptional folks we hire. The base salary range for this position is $102,000-$120,000. Discover our benefits and how our employees live rewarded at https://fetch.com/careers.

Equity: We offer full-time employees equity in Fetch, so that everyone can benefit from Fetch’s growth.401k Match: Dollar-for-dollar match up to 4%.Benefits for humans and pets: We offer comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for everyone including your pets.Continuing Education: Fetch provides ten thousand per year in education reimbursement.Employee Resource Groups: Take part in employee-led groups that are centered around fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace through events, dialogue and advocacy. jobs_results.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs. 
  
  
  
   We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
  
  
  
   For more information, visit arcadia.io.
  
  

  
  
  
   Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia
  
  Analytics sits at the center of how Arcadia turns complex healthcare data into better outcomes and smarter decisions.


  On the product side, that means building and owning the productized analytics engines — risk, medical economics, episodes-of-care, and more — that power Arcadia's platform company-wide, built once and delivered at scale across our entire customer base.


  On the Customer Insights side, that means going deep on a specific customer's specific problem: custom data models, bespoke dashboards, advisory work, and long-running embedded programs that don't fit a one-size-fits-all product. We describe Customer Insights' work as sitting between a platform and a plan — more customized and hands-on than an off-the-shelf reporting product, more flexible and embedded in the customer's actual decisions than a traditional outsourced consulting engagement.


  We're currently hiring for several closely related analyst roles across this broader Analytics organization — spanning ownership of one of Arcadia's core analytics engines, program-specific analytical development for a major state Medicaid risk-stratification initiative, a ground-up registry build for a national quality organization, versatile project and retainer delivery across our health system and payer customers, and dedicated analytics support for a major national health plan's Medicaid program. All of these roles sit at the Senior Analyst or Lead Analyst level, combine technical excellence with real influence over analytic strategy and (for some placements) product direction, and shape how Arcadia and its customers use data to improve population health outcomes, reduce costs, and enable smarter healthcare decisions.


  The skills and experience below are characteristic across these roles as a set — not every requirement applies to every specific seat, and we don't expect any one candidate to bring all of it. We'll work with you during the interview process to identify which role is the best fit for your background and interests.


   What Success Looks Like


   In 3 months


  
   Ramp into your specific engagement's data model, technical stack, and stakeholder relationships — most Customer Insights engagement has real history and context to build into, not a blank slate
   Learn Arcadia's core analytics platform and toolset (QuickSight, Foundry, dbt, the AWS ecosystem) as used in your engagement
   Deliver your first piece of analytical work that demonstrates clear value to your engagement's stakeholders
  
  
   In 6 months


   
    Own meaningful pieces of delivery independently — whether that's a program's analytical development, a portfolio of retainer/project work, or a dedicated account's dashboarding and reporting
    Be a credible, independent presence in front of the customers or partners tied to your engagement
    Contribute to at least one reusable analytical asset, framework, or automation that extends beyond your immediate engagement
    Begin taking on the ongoing health of your area, not just its delivery — standing up a backlog/tech-debt process, or growing into a broader backup role alongside your engagement's primary owner, depending on placement
   
   
    In 12 months


    
     Be a recognized expert in your engagement area, trusted with its most complex or ambiguous work
     Actively identify and pursue opportunities for automation, scalability, and reuse across your work
     Have grown into deeper ownership than where you started — full backup or co-owner on an account, sole steward of a program's tech-debt and backlog, or, for analytics-engine placements, the architect shaping that engine's roadmap toward being market-leading
    
   
  
 
 
  
   What You'll Be Doing
   
    
     
       Technical Analytical Delivery


      
       Translate ambiguous or partially-scoped business and clinical questions into a concrete, buildable data plan, then build the underlying data model, code, and analysis on top of it
       Develop and maintain analytical pipelines and reusable data assets using SQL, dbt, and Arcadia's core data platform (Foundry, AWS data lake environments)
       For analytics-engine placements: serve as the lead analytics strategist for at least one of Arcadia's productized analytics engines (e.g., risk, medical economics, episodes-of-care), owning it end-to-end while contributing to others
       For engagements involving predictive or risk models: design and build the models, partnering with a dedicated Data Science team on training and validation — a consultative relationship, not a daily modeling partnership
       Build dashboards, provider scorecards, registries, self-service reporting tools, benchmarking views, and other analytical deliverables (QuickSight and beyond) on top of that modeling work, as the engagement calls for it
       Maintain the analytical integrity and quality of your work, flagging issues before they reach a customer or partner; for senior placements, oversee analytic quality standards and rigor across engagements more broadly, not just your own

       Manage delivery — whether that's a single program's delivery calendar and decision log, or a portfolio of concurrent projects across multiple customers — surfacing risks and tradeoffs before they become blocking issues
       Create client-facing materials — status decks, decision memos, technical explainers — tailored to a range of stakeholders, from highly technical counterparts to policy or business stakeholders with limited technical background
       Delegate routine or repeatable work to junior analysts as your engagement grows, and help cross-train others for coverage
       Lead cross-functional analytic initiatives that span multiple teams or engagements

       Partner with Customer Management, Growth, Product, Technical Operations, and/or Engineering — depending on placement — on account strategy, product direction, or analytics roadmap; for analytics-engine placements, partner closely with product and engineering to deliver Arcadia's analytics roadmap and contribute directly to product innovation
       Hold real authority at the boundaries where your work meets someone else's — able to require rework or hold a handoff that isn't ready (e.g., with a partner Data Science team), or push back on what's actually worth building with Customer Management, Growth, or Product, rather than defaulting to whatever's asked
       Act as an internal thought leader on your area of expertise, contributing to Arcadia's broader analytics strategy and reusable methodology — and, for some placements, an external one, representing Arcadia's analytic capabilities at customer meetings, industry conferences, and in publications
      
      Team Contribution


      
       Mentor and develop junior analysts, building organizational capacity beyond your own individual delivery
       Take ownership of your area's long-term health, not just its immediate delivery — a backlog/tech-debt log, a growing backup role on an account, or a roadmap for an analytics engine, depending on placement

       Healthcare data experience — claims and/or clinical data, with value-based care familiarity
       Direct customer- or partner-facing experience — comfortable scoping and presenting without close oversight

      Experience working within a prime contractor or partner structure on shared delivery
      Experience presenting analytic capabilities externally — customer meetings, industry conferences, publications
      Python for analysis and QA; familiarity with the AWS ecosystem, Jira, and Confluence
      Experience with data governance or data-product/monetization considerations

   What You'll Get
   
    
     
      Become a member of the talented, energized, diverse and purpose-driven Arcadian Community with decades of collective experience in population health, product development, and data science
      Employee driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development
      A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart
      Competitive compensation and strong benefits, including Flexible Time Off
     
     The opportunity to:


     
      Own real, high-stakes analytical work across some of Arcadia's most complex customer relationships and highest-visibility internal analytics products
      Work across a genuinely varied set of problems — deep technical program ownership, versatile multi-account delivery, or company-wide analytics engines, depending on placement
      Build models and analytical assets that directly shape care and coverage decisions for the members and patients they serve
     
     

     
     
     
     
      Senior Analyst: $125,000 – $145,000 a year


       Lead Analyst: $145,000 – $170,000 a year


     
    
   
  
 
 
  
   About Arcadia
  
  
   Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.
  
  
  
   

     Protect Yourself
  
  
   If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781) 202-3600 and select option 3. For more information, visit our website.
  
  
  
   

     This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI under Arcadia's custodianship as well as Arcadia Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.
  
 
 
  
   We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

  * Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times.
  * Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change.



What will you be doing? 

The Innovation Sr Manager II plays a key role in helping clients address growth, brand, and innovation challenges through Circana's Innovation and Survey portfolio solutions. This client-facing position combines consultative problem solving, project leadership and a client growth mindset to deliver actionable insights and strategic recommendations, where successful project outcomes translate to expanded client relationships and revenue growth. The role requires strong analytical and storytelling skills, a focus on client service, and the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality project execution and drive long-term client success.

Job Responsibilities

  * Champion Client Success: 
    * Translate client business challenges and objectives into actionable research and analytics solutions.
    * Manage end-to-end project execution, ensuring quality, accuracy, timeliness, and delivery against client expectations.
  * Build Strategic Relationships: Build and maintain strong client relationships, partnering with stakeholders from functional teams through the C-suite.
  * Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Generate strategic insights and develop compelling, executive-ready recommendations from analytical findings.
  * Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to drive successful project outcomes and support growth of Circana's Innovation and Survey solutions.



Requirements

  * A four-year undergraduate degree is required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Statistics or Data Science. An advanced degree is a plus.
  * 7+ years of experience incorporating consultative application of multiple data types.
  * Sound understanding and use of statistical techniques (Clustering, Multi-dimensional scaling, Segmentation, Correspondence Analysis, etc,)
  * Skilled at communicating technical subject matter to non-technical audiences
  * Excellent project management skills to manage multiple projects concurrently and to self-prioritize projects within a fast-moving environment
  * Excellent written and oral communication skills; experience with PowerPoint and story-telling




Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

  * Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  * Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  * Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  * Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  * Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  * Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  * Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.



  
Location  
This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, United States

The salary range for this role is $98,000 to $140,000.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.
